name: Carlevana Winery

tasting_price_lei.note: RARITET package: tasting of 4 Raritet wines + guided cellar tour + snacks, ~1.5 h, 400 lei/pers., min 4 / max 20 persons. Other packages: KOSHER 600 lei, LIMITED 1500 lei.

booking_required.note: Page offers 'Rezervări: 076755550' and an online booking button, and tastings run at fixed slots with min. 4 persons, but does not explicitly say booking is mandatory.

address.value: str. Ștefan cel Mare 9, s. Merenii Noi, r. Anenii Noi, MD-2065

comment: Phone +373 76755550 is labelled 'Turism' on the contacts page and is also the reservation number on the tour page. Official postal code on site is MD-2065 (agent claimed MD-6527). Tastings only Thu–Sun at 11:00/13:00/15:00; agent's 'Mon–Sun 10–18' and '200 lei' are not supported.

name: Crama Tudor

tasting_price_lei.note: No price published in allowed sources.

comment: No own website; official Facebook page facebook.com/CramaTudor exists but its content could not be read. Phone also confirmed on https://moldova.travel/en/adventure-travel/artisanal-wines-route/. ONVV lists 'Open hours: Monday - Sunday' without times, all year round, reservation required.

name: Doina Vin

tasting_price_lei.note: Tour/tasting packages (550–600 lei) appear only on third-party ticketing/aggregator sites (iTicket, GetYourGuide), not on the official site; not accepted.

comment: Official site doinavin.md shows only the Chișinău office (str. V. Alecsandri 82A, MD-2012) and phone +373 22 22 85 73 — this is an office number, not specifically a tourism line. Winery location Răzeni (Ialoveni) is from ONVV. Official site has no tourism section; Instagram/Facebook could not be read. Agent's phone +373 60 213 339 not found in any allowed source.

tasting_price_lei.note: No price published in allowed sources.

comment: No own website; ONVV lists the Facebook page facebook.com/VinariaJavgurMD as website (content not readable). ONVV also lists landline +373 24179640. Groups of at least 4 people. Agent's 'Mon–Sun 10–18' is wrong per ONVV.

name: Kazayak-Vin

address.value: str. Lenin 2, s. Cazaclia, UTA Găgăuzia

comment: ONVV lists website www.kazayak.com, but it refused connections (ECONNREFUSED) so the domain could not be confirmed; parent holding site suvorov-vin.md returned 404. ONVV phones: +373 22229198, +373 22229139, +373 29167554 — these look like office/commercial lines, not a tourism line. ONVV page has no wine-tourism info (no hours, tastings, booking), so it is unconfirmed that the winery receives visitors. Agent's phone +373 22 229 193 does not match any listed number. Cazaclia is in Ceadîr-Lunga district, UTA Găgăuzia.
